  (:step :op "write" :file "asl/packages/asl-text/src/dotenv.asl" :content "(module asl-text/tests/dotenvTest :x [runTests] :i [(asl-text/dotenv :a d)])\n\nfn firstRow text: String -> (Pair String String)\n  (optionOr (listHead (d/parseDotenv text)) (pair \"\" \"\"))\n\nfn secondRow text: String -> (Pair String String)\n  (optionOr\n    (listHead (optionOr (listTail (d/parseDotenv text)) (list)))\n    (pair \"\" \"\"))\n\nfn testParseSimple -> Bool\n  (let [(text \"FOO=bar\\nBAZ=qux\\n\")]\n    (do\n      (assert (= (listLength (d/parseDotenv text)) 2) \"two rows are parsed\")\n      (assert (= (firstRow text) (pair \"FOO\" \"bar\")) \"simple key and value\")\n      (assert (= (secondRow text) (pair \"BAZ\" \"qux\")) \"row order is retained\")\n      (assert (= (firstRow \"  SPACED  =  value  \\n\") (pair \"SPACED\" \"value\")) \"outer whitespace is trimmed\")\n      (assert (= (firstRow \"EMPTY=\\n\") (pair \"EMPTY\" \"\")) \"empty values are supported\")\n      true))\n\nfn testParseQuoted -> Bool\n  (do\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"NAME=\\\" John Doe \\\"\\n\")) \" John Doe \") \"double quotes preserve spaces\")\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"NAME='Jane Doe'\\n\")) \"Jane Doe\") \"single quotes are stripped\")\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"HASH='a#b' # comment\\n\")) \"a#b\") \"hash in single quotes is literal\")\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"HASH=\\\"a#b\\\" # comment\\n\")) \"a#b\") \"hash in double quotes is literal\")\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"ESC=\\\"a\\\\nb\\\\t\\\\\\\"c\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\"\\n\")) \"a\\nb\\t\\\"c\\\"\\\\\") \"double quoted escapes are decoded\")\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"UNKNOWN=\\\"a\\\\qb\\\"\\n\")) \"a\\\\qb\") \"unknown escapes remain literal\")\n    true))\n\nfn testExportAndComments -> Bool\n  (do\n    (assert (= (listLength (d/parseDotenv \"# comment\\n\\nexport FOO=bar\\n\")) 1) \"comments and blanks are skipped\")\n    (assert (= (firstRow \"export FOO=bar\\n\") (pair \"FOO\" \"bar\")) \"export space prefix is removed\")\n    (assert (= (firstRow \"export\\tFOO=bar\\n\") (pair \"FOO\" \"bar\")) \"export tab prefix is removed\")\n    (assert (= (firstRow \"FOO=bar # comment\\n\") (pair \"FOO\" \"bar\")) \"inline comment is removed\")\n    (assert (= (firstRow \"FOO=bar#comment\\n\") (pair \"FOO\" \"bar\")) \"unquoted hash starts a comment\")\n    true))\n\nfn testNoExpansion -> Bool\n  (do\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"PATH=$HOME/bin\\n\")) \"$HOME/bin\") \"unquoted dollars are literal\")\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"OTHER=\\\"${USER}\\\"\\n\")) \"${USER}\") \"quoted dollars are literal\")\n    (assert (= (pairSecond (firstRow \"OTHER='${USER}'\\n\")) \"${USER}\") \"single quoted dollars are literal\")\n    true))\n\nfn testMalformedLines -> Bool\n  (do\n    (assert (= (d/parseDotenv \"NO_EQUALS\\n=missing-key\\nGOOD=yes\\n\") (list (pair \"GOOD\" \"yes\"))) \"malformed rows are skipped\")\n    true))\n\nfn testRender -> Bool\n  (do\n    (assert (= (d/renderDotenv (list (pair \"FOO\" \"bar\") (pair \"BAZ\" \"qux\"))) \"FOO=bar\\nBAZ=qux\\n\") \"plain values render without quotes\")\n    (assert (= (d/renderDotenv (list (pair \"SPACED\" \" value \"))) \"SPACED=\\\" value \\\"\\n\") \"significant spaces are quoted\")\n    (assert (= (d/renderDotenv (list (pair \"ESC\" \"a\\nb\\t\\\"c\\\"\\\\\"))) \"ESC=\\\"a\\\\nb\\\\t\\\\\\\"c\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\"\\n\") \"special characters are escaped\")\n    true))\n\nfn testRenderRoundTrip -> Bool\n  (let [(rows (list\n                (pair \"PLAIN\" \"foo\")\n                (pair \"EMPTY\" \"\")\n                (pair \"SPACED\" \" value \")\n                (pair \"HASH\" \"a#b\")\n (pair \"DOLLAR\" \"${HOME}\")\n                (pair \"SINGLE\" \"'raw'\")))]\n    (do\n      (assert (= (d/parseDotenv (d/renderDotenv rows)) rows) \"special values round trip\")\n      true))\n\nfn runTests -> Bool\n  (and (testParseSimple)\n    (and (testParseQuoted)\n      (and (testExportAndComments)\n        (and (testNoExpansion)\n          (and (testMalformedLines)\n            (and (testRender) (testRenderRoundTrip)))))))\n")
```
(module asl-text/dotenv :x [parseDotenv renderDotenv] :i [])

fn tailChars chars: (List String) -> (List String)
  (optionOr (listTail chars) (list))

fn reverseChars chars: (List String) acc: (List String) -> (List String)
  (match (listHead chars)
    ((some c) (reverseChars (tailChars chars) (cons c acc)))
    ((none) acc))

fn charsToString chars: (List String) -> String
  (fold (fn [(acc String) (c String)] -> String (str acc c)) "" chars)

fn spaceChar? c: String -> Bool
  (or (= c " ") (or (= c "\t") (= c "\r")))

fn trimLeftChars chars: (List String) -> (List String)
  (match (listHead chars)
    ((some c)
      (if (spaceChar? c)
        (trimLeftChars (tailChars chars))
        chars))
    ((none) (list)))

fn trimChars chars: (List String) -> (List String)
  (reverseChars
    (trimLeftChars (reverseChars (trimLeftChars chars) (list)))
    (list))

fn trim s: String -> String
  (charsToString (trimChars (stringChars s)))

fn dropChars chars: (List String) n: Int64 -> (List String)
  (if (<= n 0)
    chars
    (dropChars (tailChars chars) (- n 1)))

fn hasPrefix chars: (List String) prefix: (List String) -> Bool
  (match (listHead prefix)
    ((some p)
      (match (listHead chars)
        ((some c)
          (if (= c p)
            (hasPrefix (tailChars chars) (tailChars prefix))
            false))
        ((none) false)))
    ((none) true))

fn stripExport s: String -> String
  (let [(chars (stringChars s))]
    (if (hasPrefix chars (stringChars "export "))
      (trim (charsToString (dropChars chars 7)))
      (if (hasPrefix chars (stringChars "export\t"))
        (trim (charsToString (dropChars chars 7)))
        s)))

fn takeUnquoted chars: (List String) acc: String -> String
  (match (listHead chars)
    ((some c)
      (if (= c "#")
        acc
        (takeUnquoted (tailChars chars) (str acc c))))
    ((none) acc))

fn doubleEscape c: String -> (Option String)
  (if (= c "n")
    (some "\n")
    (if (= c "r")
      (some "\r")
      (if (= c "t")
        (some "\t")
        (if (= c "\"")
          (some "\"")
          (if (= c "\\")
            (some "\\")
            (none))))))

fn takeDoubleQuoted chars: (List String) acc: String -> String
  (match (listHead chars)
    ((some c)
      (if (= c "\"")
        acc
        (if (= c "\\")
          (let [(rest (tailChars chars))]
            (match (listHead rest)
              ((some escaped)
                (match (doubleEscape escaped)
                  ((some decoded)
                    (takeDoubleQuoted (tailChars rest) (str acc decoded)))
                  ((none)
                    (takeDoubleQuoted (tailChars rest) (str acc "\\" escaped)))))
              ((none) (str acc "\\"))))
          (takeDoubleQuoted (tailChars chars) (str acc c)))))
    ((none) acc))

fn takeSingleQuoted chars: (List String) acc: String -> String
  (match (listHead chars)
    ((some c)
      (if (= c "'")
        acc
        (takeSingleQuoted (tailChars chars) (str acc c))))
    ((none) acc))

fn parseValue raw: String -> String
  (let [(chars (trimChars (stringChars raw)))]
    (match (listHead chars)
      ((some first)
        (if (= first "\"")
          (takeDoubleQuoted (tailChars chars) "")
          (if (= first "'")
            (takeSingleQuoted (tailChars chars) "")
            (trim (takeUnquoted chars "")))))
      ((none) "")))

fn splitAtEquals chars: (List String) keyChars: (List String) -> (Option (Pair String String))
  (match (listHead chars)
    ((some c)
      (if (= c "=")
        (some (pair
          (trim (charsToString (reverseChars keyChars (list))))
          (parseValue (charsToString (tailChars chars)))))
        (splitAtEquals (tailChars chars) (cons c keyChars))))
    ((none) (none)))

fn parseLine line: String -> (Option (Pair String String))
  (let [(lineText (trim line))]
    (if (or (= lineText "") (stringStartsWith? lineText "#"))
      (none)
      (match (splitAtEquals (stringChars (stripExport lineText)) (list))
        ((some row)
          (if (= (pairFirst row) "")
            (none)
            (some row)))
        ((none) (none)))))

fn parseDotenv s: String -> (List (Pair String String))
  (listReverse
    (fold
      (fn [(rows (List (Pair String String))) (line String)] -> (List (Pair String String))
        (match (parseLine line)
          ((some row) (cons row rows))
          ((none) rows)))
      (list)
      (stringSplit s "\n")))

fn hasChar chars: (List String) target: String -> Bool
  (match (listHead chars)
    ((some c)
      (if (= c target)
        true
        (hasChar (tailChars chars) target)))
    ((none) false))

fn specialChar? c: String -> Bool
  (or (= c "#")
    (or (= c "\"")
      (or (= c "'")
        (or (= c "\\")
          (or (= c "\n")
            (or (= c "\r") (= c "\t"))))))) :rawFields "content")
